Follow the [WG membership process](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/community/working-interest-groups#participation-levels).
This nomination is for WG membership, which is distinct from MCP organization membership.

**Nominee:** @[GitHub handle]
**Organization:** [Organization, if any]
**Discord name:** [Discord name]
**Nominator:** @[Existing WG Member or WG Lead]

**Contributions:**
Link to meaningful contributions such as proposals, PRs, reviews, documentation,
or discussions, and describe sustained participation over at least three months.

**Review:**
- [ ] Nominee demonstrates sustained participation and meaningful contributions
- [ ] Nominator is an existing WG Member or WG Lead
- [ ] Seven-day objection period completed with no objections from WG Leads,
      Core Maintainers, or Lead Maintainers
